parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The renewal duration for all prepaid resources in the service instance. The unit is specified by PeriodUnit.

parameters.name: PeriodUnit
parameters.description: The time unit for the renewal duration of all prepaid resources in the service instance, which is the unit for the Period parameter. Valid values: Month, Year. Default value: Month.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenest renew-service-instance-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-instance-id si-b58c874912fc42940000 --period-unit Month --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --period 1 --resource-period ResourceArn=acs:ecs:cn-hongkong:1488317743351199:instance/i-j6c6f3lbky38o8rpeqw2 Period=1 PeriodUnit=Month --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun computenest RenewServiceInstanceResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourcePeriod.1.Period 1 --ServiceInstanceId 'si-b58c874912fc42940000' --ResourcePeriod.1.PeriodUnit Month --ResourcePeriod.1.ResourceArn 'acs:ecs:cn-hongkong:1488317743351199:instance/i-j6c6f3lbky38o8rpeqw2' --Period 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --PeriodUnit Month
